function.name: brain_step_completed
function.description: Report that the active execution step is complete.

message.description: The evidence-grounded semantic result: include the requested finding, summary, interpretation, comparison or calculation, not merely a completion notice.

exact_collection.description: Reference an exact collection in one current_attempts record's structured evidence. Required fields: source_record_index (nonnegative integer index in current_attempts) and data_path (array of string keys or integer indexes; [] selects the root). Optional label is a nonempty string. Do not copy members; Controller binds them from the original tool data.

source_record_index.description: Index in the displayed current_attempts array.

function.name: brain_step_failed
function.description: Report that the active step cannot be achieved.

message.description: Evidence-grounded reason the objective is unachievable.

function.name: brain_replan_requested
function.description: Request a revised plan from Controller.

reason.description: Evidence-grounded reason the current strategy or plan must change.

constraints.description: Constraints the replacement plan must respect.
